newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE OKS SMALL-CAP ALKO IPO.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE OKS SMALL-CAP ALKO IPO.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange approved the initial public offering prospectus of aluminium processor Alko for listing on its small-cap parallel market, it said on Thursday.
Alko will issue 411,610 new common bearer shares with a par value of 320 drachmas. The issue price will be decided shortly before the IPO subscriptions.

Proceeds will finance the company's investment programme. The bourse also approved a convertible bond issue by construction firm K.I. Sarantopoulos and Vepal's merger with Elval. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
